Prompt Design Patterns

Four composable patterns cover the vast majority of prompt optimisation needs

  • System-prompt framing — set the model's role, constraints, and tone up front
  • Few-shot examples — show input/output pairs so the model learns your format
  • Chain-of-thought reasoning — ask the model to think step by step
  • Structured output formatting — request JSON so replies parse without clean-up
# structured output: the reply is data
Answer in JSON only:
{"label": "refund" | "other",
 "reason": "one sentence"}
When to combine: pair few-shot examples with chain-of-thought for up to 40% better output consistency, then layer patterns as needed.
